$comment: Contrast contract read by scripts/check.mjs. Each pair = [foreground, background, minimum WCAG ratio], checked in every listed mode (light/dark = theme, dawn/night = sea band). Only the pairs that check.mjs already enforced in v0.1.0 are registered; add a pair here when you add a text/UI colour. Disease hues (--d-*) are checked by a fixed rule in check.mjs: night on --sea-0/--sea-2 (night band), day on --sea-0/--sea-2/--bg (dawn) and --panel (light), all >= 4.5.

consumerOverride.$comment: Tokens the README / tokens.css comments explicitly tell consumers to re-set locally. Anything not listed here: not documented (待补).
consumerOverride.--data: README: 选择疾病用 data-accent="<id>" 或 setProperty("--data", …)；tokens.css: [data-accent="<id>"] { --data: var(--d-<id>) }
